summary.intent: Check project progress and fix a failing CI/CD deployment to Phala Cloud CVM caused by an existing CVM name conflict.
summary.outcome: Identified the root cause (missing --cvm-id flag for redeployment), patched the staging deploy workflow, committed and pushed the fix with a PR.

repo: CipherBox v1.1 milestone is 100% complete (82/82 plans across 20 phases), pending only milestone archival via /gsd:complete-milestone.
Staging TEE worker runs on Phala Cloud CVM named 'cipherbox-tee-staging' (free tier).
There are 10 outstanding human_needed verification items across phases 21 and 35 (BYO config, TEE connection, Pinata provider, baselines, Phala CVM deployment verification).

code.finding: phala deploy must include --cvm-id <name> when redeploying over an existing CVM; without it the CLI returns ERR-01-004 and fails. The -n flag is retained for fresh deploys.

workflow: phala CLI error ERR-01-004 ('A CVM with name X already exists') requires passing --cvm-id to target the existing CVM for an update rather than provisioning a new one.
This same error had been encountered locally before; the CI fix mirrors the local resolution pattern.

friction: CI job logs required multiple bash tool calls to extract (GH API, step filtering) before the exact error message was surfaced.
phala CLI flag for redeployment (--cvm-id) was not already documented in the workflow file or surfaced in the transcript — required checking CLI help.
